name: Anchore Syft (Local SBOM CLI)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source CLI and Go library; generate SBOMs for container images, directories and archives without a vendor-enforced scan quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own computer or CI runner; compute, CI and container registry costs are separate. Syft generates SBOMs rather than performing a full vulnerability assessment; Anchore commercial support is optional.
